name: easyrec

vendor.company: Studio Smart Agent Technologies (the easyrec project)
vendor.hq: Austria (Vienna). Origin tied to Austrian R&D; project received the Austrian State Prize for Multimedia/e-business 2009 and Germany's INNOVATIONSPREIS-IT 2011 per Wikipedia.
vendor.repo: https://sourceforge.net/p/easyrec/ (canonical, SVN); community Git mirrors: github.com/hernad/easyrec, github.com/imosquera/easyrec-on-github
vendor.scale: Niche/legacy. Long-tail adoption via PHP/Laravel/Django-Oscar/Drupal-Ubercart integration libraries (hafael/easyrec-php, antoineaugusti/laravel-easyrec, django-oscar-easyrec). Small absolute footprint vs modern recsys.

ports: 3306/tcp (MySQL/MariaDB, when the all-in-one Docker image is published)
443/8443 if fronted by TLS (operator-added, not default)

verification_primitive.probe: GET http://TARGET:8080/easyrec-web/api/1.1/json/otherusersalsoviewed?apikey=8ab9dc3ffcdac576d0f298043a60517a&tenantid=EASYREC_DEMO&itemid=1&itemtype=ITEM&requesteditemtype=ITEM (read-only; uses the documented demo key/tenant). Pair with GET /easyrec-web/ to confirm the title 'easyrec' first.
verification_primitive.success_signal: HTTP 200 with a JSON recommendation envelope (recommendeditems / item objects, or an empty result set) instead of the TENANT_WRONG_TENANT_APIKEY error. A non-error 200 means the EASYREC_DEMO tenant still exists with the documented key = the instance is operator-readable via a publicly-known credential. The bare title/meta-refresh on '/' confirms the platform even when the demo tenant was deleted.
verification_primitive.impact_when_open: Read access to that tenant's recommendation/item data and (with userid) per-user action history; if the demo tenant was never removed, this is unauth-equivalent. No record exfiltration needed to prove exposure - the non-error 200 plus the index title is the finding.

endpoints.returns: Welcome page jsp/index.jsp: HTML <title>easyrec</title> with meta refresh to 'home'. Confirms an easyrec instance.
Install-wizard start page (LoaderController action=home). On a not-yet-configured instance, exposes the DB setup flow; no installation-complete guard in source.

Install wizard DB-connection test. Accepts arbitrary db_host/db_name/db_username/db_password from the request and runs jdbc:mysql://{db_host}/{db_name} testConnection - a blind credential-test / outbound-connection (SSRF-style) primitive against an exposed pre-install instance.
Up to 15 recommended items as JSON: itemId, itemDescription, itemUrl, itemImageUrl, value. With the demo key on an undeleted EASYREC_DEMO tenant, returns that tenant's stored item catalog metadata.
Per-user recommendation list (item metadata) for a supplied userid.
The last actions performed by a given userId - user-linked browsing/purchase history if the supplied apikey/tenant is valid for the instance.
WRITE: records an action into the tenant. Open instance with a valid key = attacker can inject/poison action data and skew recommendations.
WRITE: creates/updates items and item-association rules. Requires a session token from /operator/signin (operator creds), so write-import needs the operator password, unlike the apikey action plane.
SOAP (JAX-WS) endpoint mirroring the REST API surface.
